## Fixed

- TV: tapping a tab on the rail again now scrolls its feed back to the top and refreshes it, on Home, Subscriptions, Music and Library, including when coming back from a channel, playlist or artist page.
- Music: tapping a mood tag such as Feel good or Romance now filters the feed, with a local fallback when YouTube Music returns no filtered page for that tag. Tapping the tag again clears the filter.
